# Daclify

> Daclify is a modular DAO platform for membership, governance, funded work, contributor payments and shared documents.

Use the app to explore DAO workspaces and the versioned handbook for accounts, voting, projects, treasury and document guides. The roadmap identifies planned capabilities, including social/Telegram login, managed recovery, independent deployments, hosted services and future chain integrations. Prices and delivery dates for these options are not announced. Encryption protects document content; public blockchain activity may remain visible.

## CommunityIQ

- [CommunityIQ](https://community-iq.com/): CommunityIQ brings people, ideas and shared knowledge together. It will use Daclify as its main DAO software to help its communities organize members, make decisions and manage shared resources.

## App and documentation

- [Daclify app](https://app.daclify.com/): DAO Hub and community workspaces.
- [Daclify handbook](https://app.daclify.com/docs): Product guides in the app; check versions and deployment-specific feature availability.

## English

- [Daclify — DAO tools for communities that govern together](https://daclify.com/): Manage DAO members, vote on proposals, fund projects and organize shared documents with Daclify. Explore the app and learn how it works in the handbook. Markdown: https://daclify.com/index.md
- [DAO membership, accounts and community workspaces | Daclify](https://daclify.com/platform/): Bring members, roles, voting and shared funds together in Daclify. Learn about DAO accounts, the discovery Hub and shared or independent deployments. Markdown: https://daclify.com/platform/index.md
- [DAO voting, project funding and contributor payments | Daclify](https://daclify.com/modules/): Discover Daclify modules for DAO voting, milestone funding, payroll and shared documents. Choose the tools that fit how your community works. Markdown: https://daclify.com/modules/index.md
- [Private DAO documents and encrypted shared records | Daclify](https://daclify.com/privacy/): Keep DAO documents organized and protect private content with encryption. Understand member access, recovery keys and the limits of public blockchain records. Markdown: https://daclify.com/privacy/index.md
- [Daclify roadmap — accounts, DAO deployments and integrations](https://daclify.com/roadmap/): Follow Daclify’s roadmap for social and Telegram login, independent DAO contracts, hosted services and future blockchain integrations. Explore the app and handbook. Markdown: https://daclify.com/roadmap/index.md
